description: NaCr₂Al(HO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent CrO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent AlH₂O₄ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.80 Å. Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent AlH₂O₄ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-45°. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.73 Å. Al is bonded to two equivalent H and four O atoms to form AlH₂O₄ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent CrO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. Both Al-H bond lengths are 2.00 Å. There are two shorter (1.82 Å) and two longer (1.83 Å) Al-O bond lengths. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Al atom. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Al atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Al atom.
